sources: Hits, frames, keys, events and the Final Strike: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0019_karin_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft; values from SkillPatchTable. Batch-2 report docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0019_karin.md (kit plan and § Kit). Not checked against a log (no fixture has Akekuri).

Hand-written where the compiler doesn't emit it (batch-2 D3): the per-hit element (DamageAction damageType 0 physical, 2 Heat on the battle skill), stagger (poise; attack4's onlyEnableForMainChar), the finisher's BreakingAttackCalculation multipliers 0.2 / 0.8, the combo's dynamic SP, the hitless ultimate's three SP grants, and the buffs the ultimate creates.

Talents and potentials: PotentialTalentEffectTable chr_0019_karin_talent_1_1/_2 (skillBbModifier sets the combo's sub_ratio, max_ratio, rate), talent 2 (the ultimate's combo = 1, imbue_scale), CharacterPotentialTable and BuffData buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_1 / _1_1 / _3 / _5 / _5_combo, _talent_2 / _talent_2_combo.

SP: every ObtainCostAction costType 1 of hers has atbGainMethod 0 (natural SP); the engine counts all kit SP as returned (open item V3), so her SP gives no team energy when spent until V3 (in-game test: report § Kit).

buffs.label: Positive Feedback (P1: ATK per layer)
buffs.note: P1: buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_1 (abilityEvent 142 + CheckObtainAtbType method [0] type [3]: she recovers SP with a skill) creates _potential_1_1: attr 2 formulaItem 6 atk_up (0.1) per layer, duration 10 s, max_stack 5, stackingType 8 (the loader makes it sharedTimer: one timer for all layers, refreshed by each new one; in-game test). Duration 0 below P1 (the source isn't unlocked).

buffs.label: SQUAD! ON ME! team ATK (P3)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_3 (attr 2 formulaItem 6 atk; lifeType 1), CreateBuff autoFinishByAction on the team at ultimate frame 0 when potential_3 > 0: lasts while her ultimate does.

buffs.label: Staying in the Zone (while the ultimate lasts)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0019_karin_talent_2 (autoFinishByAction, lifeType 1): its end (buffEvent 2) starts the P5 tail, or below P5 ends the Link (trigger zone_end).

buffs.label: Staying in the Zone Link (talent 2)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0019_karin_talent_2_combo → CreateGlobalBuffAction global_buff_combo_trigger (imbue_scale 0.2, duration 10 from the ultimate's blackboard): one team Link stack (link: true), used and ended by the next battle skill or ultimate of anyone. Whether it is a Link stack (+30% / +20%, added to combo stacks) or a fixed imbue_scale +20%, and whether the 10 s caps P5's tail: in-game test (report U2).

buffs.label: Tempo of Awareness (P5: Link 5 s past the ultimate)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_5_combo, duration potential_5_duration (5 at P5; 0 below, so not applied). Its end finishes talent_2_combo (the Link).

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER: "When an enemy becomes Staggered or hits a Stagger Node." (CharGrowthTable chr_0019_karin_ComboSkill)
The Stagger Node half of the COMBO TRIGGER (EnemyData poiseKnotPctList; Rhodagn: 0.5).

Combo frame 22 (if a target), before its DamageAction: sub_ratio /= rate (ModifyDynamicBlackboard op 3), atb_up = 1 + INT × sub_ratio (StoreAttributeValue primaryAttributeType 2, useFloor false), max_ratio += 1, atb ×= min(atb_up, max_ratio) (CompareFloat), ObtainCostAction costType 1 atbGainMethod 0 atbSourceType 3. Talent 1 sets sub_ratio 0.01 / 0.015, max_ratio 0.5 / 0.75, rate 10; unlearned sub_ratio and max_ratio are 0, so the factor is 1.
Combo frame 31: the second ObtainCostAction uses the same (already scaled) atb.
First Rallying Flare: ObtainCostAction atb_1 (26 at L12) at frame 59 (atbGainMethod 0, atbSourceType 3). The ultimate scales atb_n by its own atb_up, which is 1 (its sub_ratio is never set).
abilityEvent 142 + CheckObtainAtbType method [0] (natural) type [3] (skills): natural SP from her skills (the sp event's gain method comes from the data's atbGainMethod).
Ultimate frame 0: CreateBuff buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_3 on the team (CompareFloat potential_3 > 0).
Ultimate frame 1: CompareFloat combo ≥ 1 (talent 2 sets combo = 1) → buff_chr_0019_karin_talent_2 and _talent_2_combo.
buff_chr_0019_karin_talent_2 buffEvent 2: with buff_chr_0019_karin_potential_5 (P5's permanent marker) start potential_5_combo, else finish talent_2_combo.

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.note: No DamageAction: three SP grants (cast triggers ult_sp_1–3), P3's team ATK and talent 2's Link (ult_p3, ult_talent2).
